title: AP Managing Product Dashboard - Accessibility Test Plan (WCAG 2.1 AA)
overview: Comprehensive accessibility test plan for Assistive Partner Product Management Dashboard ensuring WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. Tests cover navigation, status tabs, product listing table, search/filter/sort controls, actions menu, and dynamic content updates.

testCases.title: Page has proper heading hierarchy
testCases.componentElement: Page heading structure (H1, H2 for sections)
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in and on Product Management dashboard
steps: 2. Use screen reader heading navigation (H key)
3. Verify H1 exists for page title
4. Verify H2 for major sections (Status Overview, Product Listing, Approval Timeline)
5. Check no heading levels are skipped
expectedResults: One H1 per page ('Product Management' or similar)
Logical heading hierarchy without skipped levels
Screen reader can navigate by headings

testCases.title: Product Management navigation link accessible
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in and on main dashboard
steps: 2. Tab to Product Management navigation link
expectedResults: Visual highlight distinguishable without color alone

testCases.title: Skip to main content link present
testCases.preconditions: User is on Product Management page
steps: 2. Press Tab once from page load
5. Verify focus moves to main content
expectedResults: Skip link is first focusable element
Focus moves to product listing area

testCases.title: Landmark regions properly defined
testCases.componentElement: Page landmark regions (banner, navigation, main, contentinfo)
testCases.preconditions: User is on Product Management page
expectedResults: Screen reader can navigate by landmarks

testCases.title: Status tabs keyboard accessible
testCases.componentElement: Status tabs (All, Approved, Under Review, Draft, Rejected)
testCases.preconditions: User is on Product Management page with status tabs visible
steps: 2. Tab to status tabs (All, Approved, Under Review, Draft, Rejected)
4. Use arrow keys to navigate between tabs
6. Verify focus remains on activated tab
expectedResults: Focus indicator visible on all tabs

testCases.title: Status tabs have proper ARIA attributes
testCases.preconditions: User is on Product Management page with screen reader enabled
steps: 1. Inspect status tabs with screen reader
expectedResults: Tabs use proper ARIA tab pattern
Tab counts announced by screen reader
aria-controls links tab to content panel
Screen reader announces 'tab X of Y'

testCases.title: Status tab counts visible and announced
testCases.preconditions: User is on Product Management page with products in various statuses
steps: 2. Verify count badges visible for each status
4. Use screen reader to verify counts announced
5. Filter products and verify counts update
6. Check updated counts announced via aria-live
expectedResults: Count badges visible on all tabs

testCases.title: Search input accessible
testCases.preconditions: User is on Product Management page
steps: 4. Verify placeholder is supplementary, not sole label
expectedResults: Search results update announced via aria-live
Input has autocomplete='off' or appropriate value

testCases.title: Filter dropdown keyboard accessible

steps: 1. Tab to Disability Type filter dropdown

steps: 1. Inspect filter dropdown with screen reader

steps: 4. Navigate sort options (Newest First, Name A-Z, etc.)

testCases.title: Filter persistence announced
testCases.preconditions: User is on Product Management page

testCases.title: Table structure semantic and accessible
testCases.preconditions: User is on Product Management page with products listed
steps: 2. Verify table uses <table> element or role='table'
3. Check table has caption or aria-label
4. Verify column headers use <th> with scope='col'
expectedResults: Table uses semantic HTML or ARIA

testCases.title: Product images have alt text
testCases.preconditions: User is on Product Management page with products listed
steps: 2. Verify all images have alt attribute

5. Use screen reader to verify alt announced
expectedResults: All product images have alt text

testCases.title: Edited icon accessible
testCases.preconditions: User is on Product Management page with an edited product visible
steps: 3. Check aria-label or visually hidden text present

testCases.title: Status indicators accessible

testCases.preconditions: User is on Product Management page with products in various statuses
